game_title: Fallback: Edge Case Hunter – Bazaar Tents
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the caravan guide must hold off sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: In Bazaar Tents, repeat each round: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code. Then check edge_cases and advance.
player_objective: Protect the camel pen from sandstorms in Bazaar Tents: keep edge_cases above zero until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Edge Case Hunter
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 9, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Sand Dunes

learning_objectives: Understand the idea behind: Debugging & Combined Skills

ui.title: Bazaar Tents: Edge Case Hunter
ui.subtitle: Hold out until the timer ends!

then: add_event_log('That choice does not match the code.')

hint: Read the code panel: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code. Keep edge_cases above zero until the timer reaches 76.

tutorial.message: Sandstorms are coming! Watch the edge_cases meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: avg = total / len(items)
Survive for 76 seconds to complete the level.

on_win.title: Level Cleared!
on_win.message: You mastered Edge Case Hunter in Sand Dunes!

on_lose.title: Try Again!
on_lose.message: edge_cases ran out. Fix the code sooner and watch the meter!
